/**
 * User Model
 *
 * This class handles all database operations related to users.
 * It provides methods for creating, reading, updating, and deleting user records.
 * All database operations use prepared statements to prevent SQL injection.
 */

class User
{
    /**
     * @var PDO The database connection instance
     */
    private PDO $pdo;

    /**
     * @var int|null The user's ID
     */
    public ?int $id;

    /**
     * @var string|null The user's name
     */
    public ?string $name;

    /**
     * @var string|null The user's email
     */
    public ?string $email;

    /**

     */
    public ?string $password_hash;

    /**
     * @var string|null The datetime when the user's email was verified
     */
    public ?string $email_verified_at;

    /**
     * @var string|null The datetime when the user was created
     */
    public ?string $created_at;

    /**
     * @var string|null The datetime when the user was last updated
     */
    public ?string $updated_at;

    /**
     * User constructor.
     *
     * @param PDO $pdo The database connection instance
     */
    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        $this->pdo = $pdo;
        $this->id = null;
        $this->name = null;
        $this->email = null;
        $this->password_hash = null;
        $this->email_verified_at = null;
        $this->created_at = null;
        $this->updated_at = null;
    }

    /**
     * Create the users table if it doesn't exist.
     *
     * @return bool True if the table was created successfully or already exists
     * @throws Exception If there was an error creating the table
     */
    public function createTable(): bool
    {
        $sql = "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
            id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
            name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
            email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
            email_verified_at DATETIME NULL,
            created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        )";

        try {
            return $this->pdo->exec($sql) !== false;
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            throw new Exception("Error creating users table: " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    /**
     * Create a new user record.
     *
     * @param string $name The user's name
     * @param string $email The user's email
     * @param string $password_hash The user's password hash
     * @return int The ID of the newly created user
     * @throws Exception If there was an error creating the user
     */
    public function create(string $name, string $email, string $password_hash): int
    {
        // Validate inputs
        if (empty($name) || empty($email) || empty($password_hash)) {
            throw new Exception("Name, email, and password are required");
        }

        if (!filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
            throw new Exception("Invalid email format");
        }

        $sql = "INSERT INTO users (name, email, password_hash) VALUES (:name, :email, :password_hash)";

        try {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
            $stmt->bindParam(':name', $name, PDO::PARAM_STR);
            $stmt->bindParam(':email', $email, PDO::PARAM_STR);
            $stmt->bindParam(':password_hash', $password_hash, PDO::PARAM_STR);
            
            if ($stmt->execute()) {
                $this->id = (int) $this->pdo->lastInsertId();
                $this->name = $name;
                $this->email = $email;
                $this->password_hash = $password_hash;
                $this->created_at = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
                $this->updated_at = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
                return $this->id;
            } else {
                throw new Exception("Failed to create user");
            }
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            throw new Exception("Error creating user: " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    /**
     * Find a user by ID.
     *
     * @param int $id The user ID
     * @return User|null The user object if found, null otherwise
     * @throws Exception If there was an error retrieving the user
     */
    public function findById(int $id): ?User
    {
        $sql = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1";

        try {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
            $stmt->bindParam(':id', $id, PDO::PARAM_INT);
            $stmt->execute();

            $data = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            if ($data) {
                $user = new User($this->pdo);
                $user->id = (int) $data['id'];
                $user->name = $data['name'];
                $user->email = $data['email'];
                $user->password_hash = $data['password_hash'];
                $user->email_verified_at = $data['email_verified_at'];
                $user->created_at = $data['created_at'];
                $user->updated_at = $data['updated_at'];
                return $user;
            }

            return null;
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            throw new Exception("Error finding user by ID: " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    /**

            $stmt->bindParam(':email', $email, PDO::PARAM_STR);
            $stmt->execute();

            $data = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

                $user->id = (int) $data['id'];

                $user->email = $data['email'];

                $user->email_verified_at = $data['email_verified_at'];
                $user->created_at = $data['created_at'];
                $user->updated_at = $data['updated_at'];
                return $user;
            }

            return null;
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            throw new Exception("Error finding user by email: " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    /**
     * Update the user record.
     *
     * @param int $id The user ID
     * @param array $data Associative array of fields to update
     * @return bool True if the update was successful
     * @throws Exception If there was an error updating the user
     */
    public function update(int $id, array $data): bool
    {
        if (empty($data)) {
            throw new Exception("No data provided for update");
        }

        // Validate email if it's being updated
        if (isset($data['email']) && !filter_var($data['email'], FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
            throw new Exception("Invalid email format");
        }

        $fields = [];
        foreach ($data as $key => $value) {
            if (in_array($key, ['name', 'email', 'password_hash', 'email_verified_at'])) {
                $fields[] = "$key = :$key";
            }
        }

        if (empty($fields)) {
            throw new Exception("No valid fields provided for update");
        }

        $sql = "UPDATE users SET " . implode(', ', $fields) . " WHERE id = :id";

        try {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
            $stmt->bindParam(':id', $id, PDO::PARAM_INT);

            foreach ($data as $key => $value) {
                if (in_array($key, ['name', 'email', 'password_hash', 'email_verified_at'])) {

            }

        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            throw new Exception("Error retrieving users: " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }
}

     */
    public function __construct()
    {
        $redisHost = getenv('REDIS_HOST') ?: 'localhost';
        $redisPort = getenv('REDIS_PORT') ?: 6379;
        $redisDb = getenv('REDIS_DB') ?: 0;
        $redisPassword = getenv('REDIS_PASSWORD') ?: null;

                $redisDb,
                $redisPort
            );
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            error_log("Failed to initialize Celery: " . $e->getMessage());
            throw $e;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Get the configured Celery instance.

     * @return Celery The Celery instance

    public function getCelery(): Celery
    {

     *
     * @param string $taskName Name of the task to execute
     * @param array<mixed> $args Arguments for the task
     * @param array<mixed> $kwargs Keyword arguments for the task
     * @return string|null Task ID if successful, null otherwise
     */
    public function dispatchTask(string $taskName, array $args = [], array $kwargs = []): ?string
    {
        try {
            $task = $this->celery->createTask($taskName);
            $result = $task->applyAsync($args, $kwargs);
            return $result->getId();
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            error_log("Failed to dispatch task {$taskName}: " . $e->getMessage());
            return null;
        }
    }

    public function getTaskResult(string $taskId)

            }
            return null;
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            error_log("Failed to get result for task {$taskId}: " . $e->getMessage());

        }
    }
